newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sells Canadian dollars - traders.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sells Canadian dollars - traders.

text.p: The Bank of Canada intervened and sold Canadian dollars for U.S. dollars on Thursday as the currency traded around the C$1.3880 level, dealers said.
They said the intervention was considered heavy as the currency strengthened through key resistance.
After the intervention, the Canadian dollar was trading at C$1.3886 after opening at C$1.3948 and Wednesday's close of C$1.3975. Traders expect further gains.
The Bank of Canada does not comment on intervention.
